notes.title: Update
notes.notes: The number of scenarios has been increased. The variety has been increased. The language selection screen at the beginning of the game has been arranged.

notes.title: Case Sealed Is Now Available!!
notes.notes: We are excited to see you, our valued players, facing the challenges of our game. We wish you the best of luck in saving your daughter and fighting criminals.

notes.title: We will be with you very soon
notes.notes:
We are happy to share Case Sealed with you.

Dear players; Our Case Sealed game will be available to you, our valued players, on Monday, May 26, 2025.

We need your justice to send the criminals to their rightful place. Your daughter needs it before us. We believe that you will fulfill your duty by making the right decisions. If you are confident, send all the criminals to their rightful place.

Help us make the game better by giving feedback on our Discord Server.

Thank you for your support. We are waiting for your feedback.
